subject: The proposed intervention is bounded to at most one reversible fulfillment or communication change, selected by the end of week one and run for the remaining four weeks.
rationale: The proposition is a prospective constraint on any intervention selected under the five-week schedule. It specifies a selection deadline, a maximum of one change, permitted change types, reversibility, and a four-week run period. These provide a sufficiently determinate and internally coherent decision structure at this scope; implementation details about reversibility and change boundaries do not defeat that structure. The proposed rule does not establish that an intervention occurred or succeeded.
